title: Articles: a, an, the
explanation: Use a before consonant sounds (a car, a university) and an before vowel sounds (an apple, an hour). Use the when both speakers know which thing you mean, or when there is only one (the sun). Use no article for general plurals and uncountables: I like dogs. Milk is healthy.
explanationPersian: قبل از صدای بی‌صدا از a و قبل از صدای صدادار از an استفاده کنید. وقتی هر دو طرف می‌دانند درباره چه چیزی صحبت می‌شود، the به کار می‌رود. برای جمع کلی و اسم‌های غیرقابل‌شمارش حرف تعریف لازم نیست.

examples.english: She bought a car and an umbrella.
examples.persian: او یک ماشین و یک چتر خرید.
examples.note: a + consonant sound, an + vowel sound

examples.english: The sun rises in the east.

examples.note: honest starts with a vowel SOUND

exercises.explanation: Engineer starts with a vowel sound, so use an.
exercises.explanationPersian: engineer با صدای مصوت شروع می‌شود، پس an می‌آید: an engineer.

exercises.explanation: University starts with a 'yu' consonant sound, so use a.
exercises.explanationPersian: کلمه university با صدای «یو» شروع می‌شود، پس a درست است.

exercises.explanation: Both people know which door — use the.
exercises.explanationPersian: هر دو نفر می‌دانند کدام در است، پس the می‌آید.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I saw an movie last night.
acceptedAnswers: I saw a movie last night.
exercises.explanation: Movie starts with a consonant sound — a movie.
exercises.explanationPersian: movie با صدای صامت شروع می‌شود، پس a می‌آید: a movie.

exercises.explanation: General, abstract ideas take no article: Life is beautiful.
exercises.explanationPersian: برای مفهوم‌های کلی و انتزاعی حرف تعریف نمی‌آید: Life is beautiful.

exercises.explanation: The h in hour is silent — it starts with a vowel sound.
exercises.explanationPersian: h در hour خوانده نمی‌شود و کلمه با صدای مصوت شروع می‌شود، پس an می‌آید.

exercises.source: او مهندس است و در یک شرکت بزرگ کار می‌کند.
acceptedAnswers: He is an engineer and works for a big company.
She is an engineer and works for a big company.
He is an engineer and works at a big company.
She is an engineer and works at a big company.
He is an engineer and he works for a big company.
She is an engineer and she works for a big company.
He is an engineer and he works at a big company.
She is an engineer and she works at a big company.

commonErrors.feedback: 'engineer' starts with a vowel sound: an engineer.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: engineer با صدای مصوت شروع می‌شود: an engineer.

exercises.explanation: an + vowel sound: an engineer. a + big company.
exercises.explanationPersian: قبل از صدای مصوت an: an engineer. a big company.
قبل از شغل a یا an لازم است.

exercises.prompt: Complete with articles: "___ sun is ___ star." (write the full sentence)
exercises.explanation: the sun (only one) + a star (one of many)
exercises.explanationPersian: the sun (فقط یکی است) + a star (یکی از چندتا)
